answer: Cap the number of new identities per epoch and sell the slots in a sealed-bid, uniform-price auction whose proceeds are burned. A farm bidding for k slots pushes the clearing price up against itself, so its total cost grows faster than k, while one honest newcomer pays the going price once. Like wind reshaping a dune, demand reshapes the price, and bids cannot be pooled because every slot is bought separately. A knoll of cheap clones never climbs to the ivory tower of full rewards.
